events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at Oakland Raiders

headlines.description: Derek Carr threw a 9-yard touchdown pass to James Jones with 1:42 remaining, and the Oakland Raiders snapped a 16-game losing streak with a 24-20 victory over the Kansas City Chiefs on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Carr, Raiders stun Chiefs to snap skid at 16

headlines.description: Brian Hoyer shook off three interceptions, leading the Cleveland Browns down the field in the final minute to set up Billy Cundiff's 37-yard field goal as time expired for a 26-24 victory over the Atlanta Falcons on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hoyer shakes off INTs, rallies Browns to win

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Chicago Bears

headlines.description: Matt Forte rushed for two touchdowns in the third quarter, and the Bears spoiled Lovie Smith's return to Chicago with a 21-13 victory over the Tampa Bay Buccaneers on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bears top Bucs, spoil Lovie's Chicago return

headlines.description: Indianapolis overcomes miscues to beat Jags 23-3
headlines.shortLinkText: Indianapolis overcomes miscues to beat Jags 23-3

events.name: Green Bay Packers at Minnesota Vikings

headlines.description: Eddie Lacy rushed for 125 yards on 25 carries, both season highs to help Aaron Rodgers and the Green Bay Packers hang on for a 24-21 victory over the Minnesota Vikings on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lacy, Rodgers too much as Pack edge Vikes

events.name: Detroit Lions at New England Patriots

headlines.description: Brady passes Patriots to 34-9 win over Lions
headlines.shortLinkText: Brady, Pats keep rolling, stretch streak to 7

headlines.description: Huff, McCoy lead Eagles past Titans 43-24
headlines.shortLinkText: Huff, McCoy lead Eagles past Titans 43-24

headlines.description: Dalton helps Bengals to 22-13 win over Texans
headlines.shortLinkText: Dalton helps Bengals to 22-13 win over Texans

events.name: St. Louis Rams at San Diego Chargers

headlines.description: Marcus Gilchrist intercepted Shaun Hill at the goal line with 56 seconds left to preserve the San Diego Chargers' 27-24 victory over the St. Louis Rams on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chargers survive Rams' furious late rally

headlines.description: Russell Wilson found backup tight end Cooper Helfet for a 20-yard catch-and-run touchdown late in the third quarter, Steven Hauschka kicked four field goals and the Seahawks handed the Cardinals their second loss of the season, 19-3 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Seahawks stifle Cardinals, stay in West race

headlines.description: Peyton Manning threw three of his four TD passes to Demaryius Thomas, and C.J. Anderson ran for 167 yards and the go-ahead score in the Denver Broncos' 39-36 win over the Miami Dolphins on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Manning, Anderson lift Broncos over Dolphins

headlines.description: Carlos Hyde ran for a go-ahead, 4-yard touchdown with 2:59 remaining, and the San Francisco 49ers squeaked by the lowly Washington Redskins with a 17-13 win Sunday that kept them in the thick of the playoff chase.
headlines.shortLinkText: Niners squeak by Redskins on Hyde's late TD

events.name: Dallas Cowboys at New York Giants

headlines.description: Tony Romo upstaged Odell Beckham Jr.'s jaw-dropping one-handed touchdown catch with two third quarter touchdown passes to give the Dallas Cowboys a 24-21 lead over the New York Giants heading into the fourth quarter Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cowboys rally from 11 down to stop Giants

events.name: New York Jets at Buffalo Bills
New York Jets at Buffalo Bills

headlines.description: Kyle Orton threw two touchdown passes, Robert Woods pulled off a slick one-handed catch and Scott Chandler added a snow-themed celebration as the Buffalo Bills shook off a rough week and drubbed the New York Jets 38-3 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Displaced Bills triumph in blowout of Jets

events.name: Baltimore Ravens at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: Justin Forsett rushed for 182 yards and two touchdowns, and the Baltimore Ravens beat New Orleans 34-27 on Monday night to hand the Saints their third consecutive loss.
headlines.shortLinkText: Forsett runs wild as Ravens hold down Saints
